name: DuoStatusBar
author: Muzi
description:
Merges the iPhone status bar's battery, Wi-Fi and cellular signal icons into a single circular widget in the style of the iPhone Duo outer display.

v20 changes:
- Switched to STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar) so the indicator actually lives inside the system status bar rather than being a separate overlay window.
- Smart-invert: reads resolved foreground colour from STUIStatusBarSignalStrengthItemView.activeColor / label textColor / STUIStatusBar.foregroundColor (in priority order), so it auto-inverts against any wallpaper like the rest of the status bar.

Settings: position offsets, icon size, ring width, per-element HEX colours, debug log.
changelog:
v1.1.3 (2026-09-14)
- Enlarged the centre glyph (LTE / 5G / antenna SF Symbol) from 0.55× to 0.70× of the ring diameter so the type reads cleanly at small icon sizes.

v1.1.2 (2026-09-14)
- Cellular glyph fix: now uses -resolvedTint (full-strength tint) instead of wifiColorForConnected:NO (30% alpha), so the LTE / 5G symbol matches the smart-invert colour instead of being dimmed grey.

v1.1.1 (2026-09-14)
- Smart-invert hotfix: sample resolved activeColor/textColor/foregroundColor from system subviews, and resolve all dynamic UIColor values against the screen traitCollection before passing them to CoreGraphics.

v1.1.0 (2026-09-14)
- STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar).
- Airplane-mode indicator hook.

v1.0.0
- Initial release (UIWindow overlay).
